storyboardBeats.narration: That high-pitched squeal when you start your car? That is not your brakes.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Cold morning engine bay, hood open, frost visible on surrounding metal, breath-fog implied by cool blue morning light, slow push-in toward the front of the engine, shallow depth of field, cinematic automotive commercial look, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: It is usually the serpentine belt — one belt running your AC, power steering, and alternator.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Macro shot of a serpentine belt threaded through multiple pulleys on a running engine, slow lateral pan following the belt's path across pulleys, soft key light, shallow DOF, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: Cold mornings make it worse. The rubber stiffens, slips on the pulley, and squeals until it warms up.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Extreme macro on a single pulley and belt contact point, slow rotation visible, cool blue-white morning light gradually warming, slight motion blur suggesting slip, 9:16 vertical framing

storyboardBeats.narration: But a belt that slips today can crack and snap later — and take your alternator's charging with it.
storyboardBeats.providerScene: Close-up of a worn belt off the vehicle, visible surface cracking along the ribs, hand-free rotating turntable reveal against a clean shop backdrop, even studio light, 9:16 vertical framing
